title: Friends screen has no guest (anonymous) gate — guests see tabs/QR and hit rules-denied writes
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/friends/page.tsx:121-138 (QR button hidden for guests; GuestLockedNotice replaces tabs+lists); apps/web/src/components/auth/guest-upgrade.tsx:207-237
ios_ref: apps/ios/app/friends/index.tsx:46-276 (no isAnonymous check anywhere); reachable by guests via apps/ios/app/(tabs)/leaderboard.tsx:36 DogLeaderboard onAddFriend; apps/ios/app/friends/add.tsx:371-387
current_ios: Anonymous users who open /friends (e.g. from the dog leaderboard '加好友' CTA) get the full UI: QR button (encodes a guest uid), search, and '加好友' which fails at Firestore rules with a raw permission error Alert. Settings hides the friends disc for guests, so the gate is inconsistent.
target: Guests see title+subtitle, NO QR button, and a single locked notice: Lock icon + Guest.locked.friends text + btn-mango '綁定帳號' (Guest.upgradeCta). Tabs/lists not rendered.
fix_plan: In friends/index.tsx: `const isGuest = !!user?.isAnonymous;`. When isGuest: do not render the QR Pressable, the Segmented tabs, the ScrollView content or the QR Modal; instead render a new `GuestLockedNotice` (create apps/ios/src/components/auth/guest-locked-notice.tsx, props `{ feature: 'post'|'reactions'|'friends'|'family' }`): View {backgroundColor: colors.cardSoft, borderWidth:1, borderColor: colors.bellTint, borderRadius: radius.lg, padding: spacing.lg, gap: spacing.md}; row with lucide `Lock` size 16 color colors.ink2 + Text t(`Guest.locked.${feature}`) (14, colors.ink); then `<Button size="sm" label={t('Guest.upgradeCta')} onPress={() => router.push('/settings')} />` (settings hosts GuestUpgradeSection). Apply the same gate in friends/add.tsx: if user?.isAnonymous show the notice instead of the send button. Reusable for feed/family gates later.
verdict_reason: Verified: apps/ios/app/friends/index.tsx has no isAnonymous check. The QR button (145-147), Segmented tabs (150-160) and search/send all render for guests. Guests can reach the screen through DogLeaderboard's empty-friends CTA (dog-leaderboard.tsx:138-143 → leaderboard.tsx:36 router.push('/friends')), while settings.tsx:54 hides the friends disc for guests. On web, friends/page.tsx:121-138 hides the QR button and renders GuestLockedNotice instead of the tabs. firestore.rules:94-99 requires isRealUser() to create a friendRequest, so a guest send is rules-denied. Guest.locked.friends and Guest.upgradeCta exist. Two corrections: the ios_ref 'friends/add.tsx:371-387' is wrong because add.tsx has 125 lines (the relevant branch is add.tsx:84-100). Also, web friends/add/page.tsx has no guest gate (it only checks !user), so gating add.tsx goes beyond web parity. It is still justified because the rules deny the write.
corrected_fix_plan: Same as the auditor plan, with these changes. (a) In add.tsx, add the guest branch before the `!user` note at line 90: `user?.isAnonymous ? <GuestLockedNotice feature="friends"/> : ...`. (b) Web's CTA opens an upgrade dialog. On iOS, either render the existing <GuestUpgradeSection/> (apps/ios/src/components/settings/guest-upgrade-section.tsx) directly under the notice so the upgrade happens in place, or use router.navigate('/settings') rather than push so the tab is reused. (c) Map the notice colours as web amber-50/amber-200/amber-900 → colors.cardSoft / colors.bellTint / colors.ink. Give the lucide Lock icon size 16 and marginTop 2.

title: Friends/requests have no loading state and listener errors are swallowed (empty-state flash / permanent false empty)
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/friends/page.tsx:37, 154-157, 188-191 (Common.loading while fetching)
current_ios: friends/requests start as [] and render '尚未加任何好友' / '尚無交友邀請' immediately until the first snapshot arrives; subscribeFriends/subscribeFriendRequests are called without onError, so a permission/network error leaves the screen showing the empty state forever with no message.
target: Show loading until first snapshot of each listener; on listener error show an inline error line instead of the empty state.
fix_plan: Add `const [friendsReady,setFriendsReady]=useState(false)`, `const [requestsReady,setRequestsReady]=useState(false)`, `const [loadError,setLoadError]=useState<string|null>(null)`. In the effect: subscribeFriends(user.uid, (f)=>{setFriends(f); setFriendsReady(true);}, (e)=>{setFriendsReady(true); setLoadError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : t('Common.loading'))}) and same for requests; reset ready flags when user changes. Render `<Text style={{fontSize:14,color:colors.ink2}}>{t('Common.loading')}</Text>` (or ActivityIndicator color brand) while !ready for the active tab; render loadError as `<Text style={{fontSize:14,color:colors.danger}}>` above the list (web line 152 pattern).
verdict_reason: Verified: friends and requests start as [] (index.tsx:50-51). subscribeFriends and subscribeFriendRequests are called without onError (62-63), although friends-read.ts:33/49 accepts one. Empty states render immediately (164-165, 180-181), and a listener error leaves a permanent false-empty screen. Web shows tC('loading') while loading (154-156, 188-190). The plan uses t('Common.loading') as the error fallback text, which is semantically wrong.
corrected_fix_plan: As auditor, except: error fallback = `e instanceof Error ? e.message : t('Error.title')` (Error.title = '出了點狀況' exists). Render the loading row as Text 14 colors.ink2 t('Common.loading'), matching web text, or an ActivityIndicator. Reset friendsReady/requestsReady/loadError at the top of the effect when user changes.

title: Request row actions are text pills (flat brand '接受' / grey '拒絕') instead of icon buttons Check (green tint) + UserX; no busy guard; hard-coded '失敗' alerts
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/friends/page.tsx:67-89, 195-224
current_ios: Two 44pt pill Pressables with text t('Friends.accept') on flat colors.brand and t('Friends.reject') on bgAlt. No disabled/busy state, so double-tap fires the acceptFriendRequest callable twice. Failure shows Alert.alert('失敗') (hard-coded, no detail).
target: Two square icon buttons (40-44pt, radius sm): accept = Check icon 16 on green tint (web emerald-100/emerald-700 → mango leafTint/leaf), aria Friends.accept; reject = UserX icon 16 on transparent, ink2 (red on press), aria Friends.reject. Disabled while busy for that row. Errors shown inline (red text) with err.message.
fix_plan: Import Check, UserX from lucide-react-native. Add `const [busy,setBusy]=useState<string|null>(null)` and `const [error,setError]=useState<string|null>(null)`. accept(r): setBusy(r.fromUid); setError(null); try await acceptFriendRequest(r.fromUid) catch(e) setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : t('Friends.add.failed')) finally setBusy(null). reject(r) same with r.requestId. Replace pills with Pressable {width:44,height:44,borderRadius: radius.sm, alignItems/justify center} — accept style {backgroundColor: colors.leafTint}, icon `<Check size={16} color={colors.leaf} strokeWidth={2.2}/>`, accessibilityLabel t('Friends.accept'), disabled={busy===r.fromUid}; reject style transparent, `<UserX size={16} color={pressed?colors.danger:colors.ink2}/>`, accessibilityLabel t('Friends.reject'), disabled={busy===r.requestId}; opacity 0.5 when disabled. Render `error` as Text {fontSize:14,color:colors.danger,marginBottom:spacing.md} under the tabs. Remove all Alert.alert('失敗').
verdict_reason: Verified: iOS index.tsx:190-195 renders text pills: flat colors.brand '接受' and bgAlt '拒絕', radius pill, with no disabled/busy state. accept/reject (120-134) show Alert.alert('失敗') hard-coded. Web 205-222: Check size-4 on emerald-100/emerald-700 (aria Friends.accept) and UserX ghost (aria Friends.reject), both rounded-lg p-2, disabled per busy id, with the accept error surfaced inline (73-74, 152). Mapping emerald → leafTint/leaf is consistent with the design system. The plan is correct and iOS-only.

title: Friend row remove uses X icon with no a11y label; confirm buttons hard-coded '取消/移除'; no busy guard
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/friends/page.tsx:91-111, 164-185 (UserMinus icon, aria Common.delete, danger confirm)
current_ios: `<X size={16} color={colors.ink3}/>` in a 24pt Pressable (padding 4, hitSlop 6) without accessibilityLabel; Alert buttons '取消' / '移除' and failure Alert '失敗' are hard-coded Chinese; repeat taps can fire removeFriend twice.

fix_plan: Swap X → UserMinus (lucide-react-native). Pressable {width:44,height:44,borderRadius: radius.sm, alignItems/justify center}, accessibilityLabel t('Common.delete'), disabled={busy===f.uid}, icon color pressed ? colors.danger : colors.ink2. confirmRemove: Alert.alert(t('Friends.removeConfirm'), f.displayName, [{text:t('Common.cancel'),style:'cancel'},{text:t('Common.delete'),style:'destructive',onPress: async()=>{setBusy(f.uid);setError(null);try{await removeFriend(f.uid)}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:t('Friends.add.failed'))}finally{setBusy(null)}}}]). Keep the iOS title Friends.removeConfirm (clearer than web's generic Common.delete title).
verdict_reason: Verified: index.tsx:171-173 renders an X icon (ink3) in a Pressable with padding 4 + hitSlop 6 (about 36pt effective) and no accessibilityLabel. The Alert buttons '取消'/'移除' and the failure Alert('失敗') at 110-117 are hard-coded, and there is no busy guard. Web 174-182 uses UserMinus size-4, aria tC('delete'), disabled while busy, with a confirm using Common.delete/Common.cancel (danger). The keys exist and the plan is correct.

title: Search tab: emoji '🔍' button, flat-brand text-only '加好友', no 'no results' state, search/send errors swallowed, hard-coded strings
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/friends/friend-search.tsx:29-41 (error surfaced), 66-76 (Input + primary Button with Search icon), 97-109 (primary sm Button UserPlus + 加好友 / ghost 已是好友/已送出), 116-118 (Common.none when no results)
current_ios: Search button is a 48pt brandTint square containing the emoji '🔍'. runSearch catch sets results [] silently. Result rows show a flat colors.brand pill with text '加好友' / grey '已是好友' / '已送出' (all hard-coded, no icon). After a search with zero hits nothing is shown. friends-write throws '不能加自己為好友' / '已是好友' literals.
target: Input (h40-48, radius md, hairline) + btn-mango gradient square button with lucide Search 16 white icon (disabled while searching). Result row button: primary (gradient, white) with UserPlus 14 + '加好友'; when already/sent → ghost (transparent, ink2) with '已是好友' / '已送出'. Empty result → centered Common.none (14, ink2, py 12). Errors shown inline red.
fix_plan: Search button: replace emoji Text with `<LinearGradient colors={mangoGradient.colors} locations={mangoGradient.locations} start={mangoGradient.start} end={mangoGradient.end} style={{width:48,height:48,borderRadius:radius.md,alignItems:'center',justifyContent:'center'}}><Search size={16} color="#fff"/></LinearGradient>` inside the Pressable, accessibilityLabel t('Friends.tabs.search'), disabled={searching}, + shadows.mango. Track `const [searched,setSearched]=useState(false)` and `searchError`; in catch set searchError (e.message). After results map: `{searched && !searching && results.length===0 ? <Text style={{textAlign:'center',color:colors.ink2,fontSize:14,paddingVertical:12}}>{t('Common.none')}</Text> : null}`. Result button: use `<Button size="sm" variant={already||sent?'ghost':'primary'} disabled={already||sent} label={...} icon={already||sent?undefined:<UserPlus size={14} color="#fff"/>}/>` from @/components/ui, labels from new keys Friends.alreadyFriends / Friends.requestSent / Friends.addFriend. In friends-write.ts replace thrown literals with t('Friends.add.self') / t('Friends.alreadyFriends') (import t from '@/lib/i18n').
needs_new_i18n_keys: Friends.addFriend = 加好友 | Add friend
Friends.alreadyFriends = 已是好友 | Already friends
Friends.requestSent = 已送出 | Sent
verdict_reason: The gap is real: index.tsx:214-216 has an emoji '🔍' on a brandTint square. runSearch's catch (84-85) swallows errors. There is no zero-results line, and labels '已是好友/已送出/加好友' (235) are hard-coded. friends-write.ts:150/158 throw zh literals. Web friend-search.tsx: primary Button with Search size-4 (73-75), inline error (78), primary sm with UserPlus size-3.5 / ghost labels (97-109), and Common.none (116-118). Two plan defects: (1) it reuses the proposed Friends.add.self ('這是你自己的 QR code 喔') for friends-write's generic self-add error, which is wrong copy for that path. (2) It relies on the ui Button `icon` prop, which wraps the node in <Text> and has no current caller passing a lucide icon (see SOCIAL-M1).
corrected_fix_plan: As auditor, with these changes. In friends-write.ts use new key Friends.cannotAddSelf ('不能加自己為好友' | "You can't add yourself") for the self-add throw, and Friends.alreadyFriends for the already-friends throw (import { t } from '@/lib/i18n'). Do not use Friends.add.self there. For the search submit button, use a dedicated Pressable (48x48, radius.md, LinearGradient mangoGradient, Search 16 #fff, disabled={searching}, opacity 0.7 when disabled, shadows.mango, accessibilityLabel t('Friends.tabs.search')). For result rows, use the ui Button only after SOCIAL-M1 lands; otherwise use a small custom Pressable (height 36, paddingHorizontal 12, radius.sm, gradient + UserPlus 14 #fff + label 14/500 #fff; ghost = transparent + ink2 text). Also add a per-row `sending` uid guard as web does (disabled={already||sent||sending===u.uid}). New keys: Friends.addFriend, Friends.alreadyFriends, Friends.requestSent, Friends.cannotAddSelf.

title: Friend-add: error state removes the send button (no retry) and hides the real error; not-found has no back CTA; back() dead-ends on cold deep link
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/friends/add/page.tsx:53-75 (error keeps button, shows err.message), 94-107 (not-found EmptyState with Back button → /app/friends), 79-88
current_ios: On sendFriendRequest failure status='error' replaces the button with t('Friends.add.failed') — the user cannot retry and doesn't learn why (e.g. '已是好友'). Not-found shows emoji + text with no action. Header back uses router.back() which is a no-op when the screen was opened cold via mangopet://friends/add.
target: Error: keep the send button enabled and show err.message (fallback Friends.add.failed) beneath it. Not-found: EmptyState with X icon + secondary Common.back button. Back: go back if possible, otherwise replace to /friends.
fix_plan: Add `const [error,setError]=useState<string|null>(null)`; in catch: setStatus('idle'); setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : t('Friends.add.failed')). Render the button whenever status is 'idle'|'sending' and render `{error ? <Text style={styles.errNote}>{error}</Text> : null}` below it (errNote color → colors.danger). Back handler: `const goBack = () => router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/friends')`; use it for the header arrow and for a `<Button variant="secondary" label={t('Common.back')} onPress={goBack}/>` in the not-found branch (replace 🔍 emoji with lucide X 24 in a brandTint tile, same as SOCIAL-7 empty card). Also prefetch whether target is already a friend (users/{me}/friends/{uid} get) and show the alreadyFriends state instead of the button.
verdict_reason: Verified: add.tsx catch (54-56) sets status 'error' without keeping the message, and the 'error' branch (88-89) replaces the send button, so the user cannot retry. Web add/page.tsx:71-74 keeps the button (status 'error' falls through to the Button branch, disabled only while sending) and shows err.message (139). Not-found (73-77) shows emoji + text with no action, while web 95-107 shows EmptyState X + secondary Common.back. _layout.tsx sets no unstable_settings/initialRouteName, so a cold mangopet://friends/add deep link has nothing to go back to and router.back() (62) dead-ends. The 'prefetch already-friends' step goes beyond web and is optional.
